Position: Python Developer

Position Summary
We are hiring a Python Developer to join NovaEdge Systems, an enterprise software company building scalable backend platforms for digital commerce and real-time data processing. This role is an individual contributor position within the Platform Engineering team and reports to the Lead Backend Engineer. You will design, develop, and operate backend services and APIs that power internal products and external client integrations. The ideal candidate is pragmatic, quality-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative engineering environment.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture, Design and Development
- Design, implement, and maintain backend services and REST/HTTP APIs using Python frameworks.
- Build scalable, high-throughput services that meet performance and reliability targets.
- Implement caching strategies and session management using Redis to optimize response times and reduce load on primary data stores.
- Develop endpoints and business logic using Django for monolithic or admin-facing components and FastAPI for lightweight, high-performance microservices.

API and Integration Engineering
- Define API contracts, implement versioning strategies, and maintain comprehensive API documentation.
- Integrate services with internal systems and third-party APIs, ensuring secure authentication, authorization, and data validation.
- Participate in API design reviews and provide feedback to improve consistency and maintainability across services.

Testing, Quality and Observability
- Develop unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality and reduce regressions.
- Instrument services with logging, metrics, and tracing to facilitate production diagnostics and performance monitoring.
- Participate in code reviews and maintain high standards for test coverage and code clarity.

Operational Excellence and Support
- Deploy and operate services in production, participate in on-call rotations, and respond to incidents with a focus on root cause analysis and preventative measures.
- Collaborate with DevOps and SRE teams to define CI/CD pipelines, deployment strategies, and rollback procedures.
- Continuously improve system reliability, scalability, and deployment velocity.

Collaboration and Process
- Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineering teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
- Contribute to architectural discussions and help shape technical roadmaps.
- Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge through documentation and brown-bag sessions.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- 0+ years

Technical Skills (Required / Mandatory)
- Python
- Redis
- Django
- FastAPI

Preferred Qualifications (Good-to-have)
- PostgreSQL
- Celery
- Microservices
- Apache Kafka

Success Metrics
- Time-to-market: ability to design and deliver production-ready features within committed sprint cycles.
- Reliability: maintain service availability and reduce production incidents measured by mean time to recovery (MTTR) and incident frequency.
- Performance: meet response-time and throughput targets for critical APIs, and demonstrate improvements via benchmarking and monitoring.
- Quality: maintain or improve test coverage and reduce defect density in released code.
- Collaboration: timely completion of cross-functional deliverables and constructive participation in design and code reviews.

Location and Work Mode
Bengaluru, on-site 5 days a week. No remote option.
